alternatives.name: Serena
alternatives.why_not_default: This is the exact-symbol and reference lane that complements c12's semantic search, and the requirement's 'exact code' clause fits it best. It was observed natively in Claude ('Actual fetch symbol and 3 references retrieved'), in Codex, and with 23 tools in Desktop (component-history.json lines 101-103). It is not the default code slot because the installed version is 2.0.0.dev0 @ c6fbd1c5 (line 99), which does not match the packet pin v1.7.0, and no automatic index refresh is recorded for it. There is no measured comparison of exact-source recall against c12.

alternatives.name: omniroute
alternatives.why_not_default: The gateway completed one text-only Responses request: HTTP 200 with 81+55=136 tokens. Two failed attempts came first, a 400 version rejection and a 499 client disconnect, and their usage is unknown (astra-receipt.json attempts 1-3). The receipt states that model tools, hooks, MCP, memory, compaction and worker parity were not demonstrated, and that the native worker remains the default. The gateway strips max_output_tokens. health-receipt.json only checks status. The recipe script hardcodes its request file (omniroute-astra.py line 38), so it cannot run another task without an edit.

alternatives.name: deerflow
alternatives.why_not_default: The evidence is one embedded invoke_acp_agent research prompt: 31027 ms, 42345 cumulative tokens, correct counts returned. There was no DeerFlow planner, UI, scheduler or standing service. It ran development commit 42334f26 (backend 2.1.0-rc0), not stable v2.0.0. DeerFlow discards ACP usage, so usage came from private adapter logs. The task explicitly forbade MCP tools (deerflow/research-task.md line 3), so tool support through this route is untested. The earlier discovery receipt was model-free.

alternatives.name: codex-acp
alternatives.why_not_default: It worked as the ACP transport for the single DeerFlow prompt. ACP 1.12.0's read-only mode maps to workspaceWrite with approvalPolicy on-request, so strict filesystem read-only is not enforced (research-receipt.json limitations and sandbox_policy). For enforced read-only research, the hardcoded read-only launcher of the native SDK path (c20; workers/research-task.md line 10) is the one to use.

alternatives.name: Context Mode
alternatives.why_not_default: It is a tool-output lane, not durable or retrievable project knowledge. In native Codex, ctx_execute_file and ctx_stats succeeded (component-history.json line 117), and 11 direct Desktop tools were exposed (observability/restart-receipt.json). In the SDK worker, ctx_execute_file failed in all three recorded turns: workers/receipt.json lines 77, 163 and 200, the first failing on the project-root restriction (line 111). ctx_execute extraction completed. Zero estimated_tokens_saved is recorded only in workers/receipt.json line 94 and restart-receipt.json line 62. component-history.json line 240 retains a historical nonzero five-call ctx_stats estimate (2.7K/62.3%). All of these are estimates, not provider savings.

Actual model: the client reports claude-opus-5-5[1m]. The fixed packet model field (opus/high) was copied as instructed.

Revision corrections from the refuters, re-verified against source: c12 relabelled as semantic retrieval, with the choice over c9 justified; c11 failure count corrected to three and the zero-savings claim scoped; the 8/12 source located (retrieval-evaluation, QMD only); c8 and c1 reclassified as local_integration; c5 and c17 removed for lack of evidence; the overturn protocol corrected for hardcoded prompts and mismatched tasks.

I did not open blueprints/us-equities/workers/native_worker.py this round. Its --prompt interface is taken from workers/research-task.md line 3, and whether its workspace can include the DeerFlow input JSONs is unverified.

The only verification is opened files; I ran no commands. Private logs and hashes referenced by the receipts cannot be checked.
Large receipts were read only in bounded sections, as listed in sources_read.
All native evidence is dated 2026-09-19 on this host. It is historical, not current availability, and does not carry over to another PC.
The packet withholds current_choice and decision labels, so this verdict could not be compared against the catalog's recorded decision.
open_gaps: There is no measured head-to-head comparison between the worker routes (native SDK, DeerFlow/ACP, OmniRoute). Each ran a different single task, and the two task files differ: workers/research-task.md is an unfilled template, and deerflow/research-task.md forbids MCP tools. No route is established as a universal winner.

Native SDK worker: all three native turns completed, but only 1 of 3 tasks succeeded (successful_research_tasks 1, blocked_file_extraction_tasks 2; workers/receipt.json lines 218-219). ctx_execute_file failed in every turn. A general success rate is unestablished.
The configured model and provider identity is not an independent per-request provider attestation, and model-reroute notifications were not collected in the SDK run.

Retrieval quality for the winners is unmeasured. The only measurement is QMD BM25 recall@3 of 8/12 on 12 curated, non-holdout queries (retrieval-evaluation/README.md line 28; receipt.json line 706). The README says it does not evaluate SocratiCode or memory (line 141). SocratiCode evidence is one limit-1 query with score 0.6429.

No financial-document corpus with as-of, source or tenant metadata exists, and no dated financial-source retrieval was exercised. The requirement's 'dated financial sources' clause is unmet by all candidates.

c12 versus c9 for exact code retrieval is an unmeasured trade-off: c12 matches its pin and refreshes its index automatically, while c9 is the exact-symbol lane but runs a dev snapshot that differs from its pin.

ai-memory: the heuristic handoff injection stays active even with the briefing disabled (component-history.json). Independent key recovery, off-host durability and new-host rebinding are not qualified (packet limitations line 721).
Non-adopted newcomers c5 (loopx), c17 (beads) and c18 have no retained evidence, so they are not listed as alternatives. They are untested, not failed.
The read-only filesystem sandbox does not restrict inherited MCP or remote-tool mutation authority, so the broker-tool exclusion depends on the environment.

arms: c20 native Codex SDK worker via native_worker.py run --prompt (default)
c6 OmniRoute Responses route (requires parameterizing omniroute-astra.py first)
c7 ai-memory + c12 SocratiCode retrieval (default) vs c9 Serena exact-symbol vs QMD BM25 baseline vs any source-reviewed challenger (c2, c15, c3)
overturn_protocol.metric: Worker routes are measured on the same no-MCP task, deerflow/research-task.md, with these fields per route: exact-field correctness against the input receipts, strict filesystem read-only enforced (yes/no), model-identity evidence, and complete native usage including failed or blocked turns. Tool/MCP success is scored in a separate task that permits tools. Retrieval is exact intended-source recall@3 and abstention on a new held-out set with frozen queries and fixed gold, at a fixed context budget. The existing QMD BM25 run (8/12) is the format template and baseline, not a held-out set.

overturn_when:
1. Worker routes. Run the concrete DeerFlow task blueprints/us-equities/deerflow/research-task.md through two routes with the same two input JSON files in the workspace. The routes are `python3 blueprints/us-equities/deerflow/native-research.py`, which hardcodes this prompt at line 84, and `python3 blueprints/us-equities/workers/native_worker.py run --prompt` with that same task text. Change the c20 default if c19+c21 matches c20 on exact-field correctness and complete usage including failed turns, while enforcing strict filesystem read-only. The task forbids MCP tools, so this pair scores the no-tool case only. OmniRoute (c6) can join only after omniroute-astra.py and omniroute-astra-request.json are changed to accept the same task, because the request is hardcoded at line 38. That change does not exist yet.
2. Retrieval. The only runnable retrieval measurement is `CI=true node blueprints/us-equities/retrieval-evaluation/run-bm25.mjs --fixture blueprints/us-equities/retrieval-evaluation/fixture.json` (README lines 125-130). It scores QMD BM25 only, at 8/12 recall@3. Use its frozen-query and fixed-gold format as the template for a new held-out code and financial-document set. Change the c7/c12 verdict only if another candidate, run at the same context budget, improves exact-source recall@3 and abstention over ai-memory+SocratiCode, or over Serena for exact symbols. An ai-memory or SocratiCode runner does not exist yet.
why_selected:
Source of these verdicts: I reviewed the retained receipts myself. The coordinator supplied no TypeSafe inference results, and I did not treat the packet's withheld labels or any provider judgment as authority. Each winner was executed natively in a real client task. None has been measured head-to-head against its alternatives.

- c20, codex-native-sdk (worker). blueprints/us-equities/workers/receipt.json (2026-09-19, native_model_e2e) records a native SDK run with openai-codex 0.154.0 and native-codex 0.155.1, configured model gpt-6-astra. It completed in 58410 ms and returned exact facts: engine_data_points 3943, simulated orders 3, failed data requests 0 and deerflow_skills 23. Usage was 135311 total tokens for that turn and 204091 across all three native turns. The receipt also records failures. All three turns have native_turn_status "completed" (lines 135, 172 and the main run). ctx_execute_file failed in every turn (lines 77, 163, 200), and the summary is successful_research_tasks 1 and blocked_file_extraction_tasks 2 (lines 218-219). policy.md sets the contract: read-only, no orders, one retrieval lane per artifact, and native usage reported only when the provider returns it. routing/astra-receipt.json (result.native_worker_remains_default: true) and routing/README.md keep this as the default over the gateway.
- c7, ai-memory (durable project knowledge and cross-client continuity). evidence/receipts/native-memory.json records a native Codex 0.155.1 session (gpt-6-astra) and a native Claude 2.1.277 session (claude-opus-5[1m]). Both retrieved the same scoped durable page through MCP memory_read_page, with 8 and 9 lifecycle observations, and cross_client_handoff_received is true. native-context-memory.json shows memory_status called with an explicit agent-lab workspace and project. This satisfies the requirement's "explicit project scope" clause.
- c12, SocratiCode (semantic code retrieval; exact-symbol lookup is Serena's lane, see c9). evidence/receipts/native-rag.json records native Codex and native Claude each making one limit-1 codebase_search (lines 31-35, 58). Both returned the same chunk, tools/ecosystem/linux-usage-report.cjs lines 2-39, score 0.6429 (lines 38, 62), so the source location is recoverable. The index held 35 files and 139 chunks (lines 91-92), with real local embeddings from nvidia/Nemotron-3-Embed-1B-BF16 at 2048 dimensions (lines 101-102). automatic_watch observed add, update and delete with no SocratiCode call between mutation and observation (lines 113-130).

Why c12 rather than c9 Serena for the code slot. Serena was also observed natively in Claude, Codex and Desktop (component-history.json lines 101-103). c12 is preferred on two grounds. First, its installed version matches the packet pin v1.14.0, while Serena runs 2.0.0.dev0 @ c6fbd1c5 (component-history.json line 99) against the pin v1.7.0. Second, c12 has an observed automatic index refresh. The two are complementary lanes, and this is a trade-off rather than a quality result.

Retrieval quality is not measured for any winner. The repository's only retrieval measurement is QMD BM25: exact intended-source recall@3 of 8/12 (blueprints/us-equities/retrieval-evaluation/README.md line 28). Line 141 of that README states it does not evaluate SocratiCode or memory.
